name: Trick or Treat
summary: A glossy Halloween candy world: hard-candy shine, gummy jelly, matte marshmallow and chocolate on a melting chocolate floor.
description: Everything in the world is edible and rendered like a premium candy ad: every shape gets a top-left radial gradient, sharp white speculars, a lower-right rim light and one soft cocoa-plum silhouette outline. Characters are hard candy, licorice, two-layer gummies, marshmallow and dark chocolate with glowing caramel cracks. The floor is a milk-chocolate bar grid with caramel pools, pink sugar-sand, mint frosting and dark cookie-crumb paths, strewn with sprinkles. Cute, saturated and sticky-sweet, but never flat vector.
bestFor: cute top-down action games with many figures
avoidFor: UIs that need a calm neutral palette

difficulty.why: Every new asset needs a real candy material (hard candy, gummy, licorice, marshmallow, chocolate) built from a light/mid/dark gradient triple plus clipped material passes, rim light and placed speculars; making the gloss convincing takes iterations, and each added asset pushes the screen closer to candy chaos, so new colours must reuse the existing triples and sprinkle set.

technique.resolution: Native resolution. Sprites baked once at K = clamp(round(S*1.25), 3, 6) px per world unit (S = screen px per unit, 360 units tall); ground decals at 4 px/unit; ground chunks per-pixel at up to 2.5 px/unit.
technique.summary: Each body part is a path filled with a top-left radial gradient (light, mid at 50%, dark), then layered with clipped material passes (jelly edge, rim light, stripes, ribs) and sharp white speculars; the finished sprite gets a soft cocoa outline by stamping a tinted copy 12 times around itself.
technique.linework: No internal ink lines. One outer silhouette outline in cocoa-plum #3a1424, 0.5 world units wide (0.45 on marshmallow figures in #5a3a66, 0.6 on the large creature, 0.4 on collectibles, 0.18 on sprinkles), produced by drawing a solid-tinted copy offset in 12 (16 if > 2.5 px) directions. Inner detail is done with colour and translucent strokes (0.35-0.7 units, round caps/joins).
technique.shading: Rendered, not cel: radial gradient centred at (cx - 0.38r, cy - 0.45r) from r*0.05 to r*1.18 with stops light / mid @0.5 / dark @1. Materials add clipped passes: hard candy = inner warm glow + ribs + rim; gummy = milky core, 0.42r saturated edge band, subsurface glow lower-right; marshmallow = soft white-to-lilac gradient without sharp specs; chocolate = dark brown gradient + peach rim light.
technique.lighting: One key light from the top-left on everything. Sharp white specular ellipses at the upper-left (alpha 0.9-0.95), a tiny dot specular above, a weak secondary reflection lower-left or lower-right (alpha 0.45-0.55). Rim light on the lower-right edge via a clipped diagonal gradient stroke. Warm caramel glow (additive) behind the main character's head and inside carved faces. Plum radial vignette on screen.
technique.texture: Material textures only: sugar crystals (0.45-unit white squares), candy stripes, licorice twist grooves, piped frosting ridges, sprinkles. Ground: per-texel hash grain on sugar-sand, Worley crumb cells on cookie paths, sine ridges on frosting, sine gloss streaks on caramel.

palette.name: Milk chocolate
palette.role: Ground base, moulded into rows of bars of varying height and offset (~45% of the screen)

palette.name: Choc groove
palette.role: 0.9-unit grooves of the 34-unit chocolate bar grid

palette.name: Caramel edge
palette.role: Caramel pool edge band and bright lip

palette.name: Mint frosting
palette.role: Mint frosting meadows with piped ridges

palette.name: Cocoa outline
palette.role: Universal silhouette outline, HUD borders, text outline, shadow hue

palette.name: Candy orange
palette.role: Main character's round hard-candy head, mid tone (light #ffd08a, dark #d24e0b)

palette.name: Caramel glow
palette.role: Light inside carved faces, glowing cracks, warm halos

palette.name: Hot pink
palette.role: Impact-star outline, stripes on numbers, UI accents

paletteRules: Every hue appears as a light/mid/dark triple inside one radial gradient; never fill a body with a single flat colour.
Highlights are pure white (#ffffff), shadows and outlines are the warm cocoa-plum #3a1424 / rgba(45,12,22,...) - never black or grey.
Ground stays mid-value and warm (chocolate, caramel, pastel pink and mint) so the saturated, high-contrast characters pop on top.
Sprinkles use the fixed set #ff4f8b #ffd23a #4fd6ff #7ee26a #b88cff #ff9a3a #ffffff and are the only place where all hues mix.
Glowing elements (carved faces, cracks, lanterns) use the caramel ramp #fffbd6 -> #ffe07a -> #ffa12a -> #e2650e.
Creature variants differ by gummy hue (purple, pink, blue) while sharing the milky white bottom layer and green jelly leaves.

typography.role: HUD numbers, timer, titles, floating numbers, card names

typography.css: font: 800 12px/1 'Sniglet', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1.6px; color: #fff3e0; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(120,30,0,.8);

world.summary: A per-pixel distance-field ground: a milk-chocolate floor (34-unit bar grid that fades into glossy melted swirls) with four material layers from fBm noise - sunken caramel pools, pink strawberry sugar-sand, raised mint frosting with dripping glossy rims, and dark cookie-crumb paths - each with antialiased edges, contact shadows and rim highlights, plus baked candy decals. Candy decals lie in a few spills, never as an even sprinkle.
layers: Milk chocolate #7e4c32: rows of bars 34/26/34/30 units high, each row with its own brick offset, each bar with its own tone (±3.5%), dark grooves and a lit top-left bevel; melting gloss bands where the bar mask is off
Caramel pools (sunken): edge #ec9c3a to deep #b25a1a, dark inner lip on the upper edge, light lip rgb(255,226,160) on the lower edge, thin sine gloss streaks
Pink sugar-sand #f4acc2: +/-3.5% grain per 0.5-unit texel, 0.3% pure white sparkle grains #fff6fa, soft drop shadow 2.6 units
Mint frosting #a0dab8 (raised): piped sine ridges, white gloss line 0.9 units inside the top edge, darker edge, drop shadow 5 units, drips up to 9 units on down-facing edges every 4.2 units
Cookie-crumb paths #543226: Worley crumb cells lit from top-left, crumbly noisy edge, sunken darker border

Decals as spills: chips, candy corn, marshmallows, sprinkle fans, hearts and gumdrops only where a low-frequency spill field peaks; sugar sparkle grain everywhere on the sand; crumbs spilling off the cookie path; calm floor between

characters.summary: Chunky toy-like figures ~18-28 units wide built from glossy primitives (ellipses, capsules, bezier blobs). Main character: a big round hard-candy orange head with a carved caramel face on a licorice body with a striped mint scarf. Creatures: two-layer gummy root bulbs (coloured top over a milky bottom), a matte marshmallow floating sheet, and a large dark-chocolate creature with glowing caramel cracks. Each part gets a material treatment; the whole sprite gets one soft cocoa silhouette outline. 4 baked walk frames per character plus a flash-tinted copy and mirrored copies; motion is mostly squash, stretch, bob and rotation at draw time.
rules: Head-heavy proportions: the main character's head is a 22x18-unit hard-candy gourd on a 9-unit licorice body.
Every part: top-left radial gradient, then at least one white specular ellipse upper-left, then a rim light lower-right.
Faces are carved holes that glow caramel (dark #7a2406 fill, then the same shape offset (0.2, 0.55) filled with a hot radial gradient) or glossy dark ellipses with yellow and white catchlights.
Material encodes the creature type: gummy = small creature, marshmallow = fast floating creature (semi-transparent at the hem), dark chocolate with glowing caramel cracks = large creature.
Outline 0.5 units #3a1424 around the whole silhouette only (0.45 #5a3a66 on marshmallow, 0.6 on the large creature); never ink inner shapes.
Keep shapes readable at 18-30 units: few large forms, small details only as speculars and stripes.

props.summary: Candy-shop scenery built with the same gloss recipe and a 0.45-unit cocoa outline (0.55 on lollipops and cupcake houses): lollipop trees, gumdrop bushes, candy-cane fences, wrapped-candy boulders, chocolate gravestones, candy buckets and cupcake houses, each with a warm soft shadow sized to the prop and y-sorted with the characters.
rules: Lollipop tree: 40-unit stick with a ribbon bow, swirl disc r 13.5 with spiral bands, inner shading, rim light and 3 speculars.
Gumdrop bush: 3 sugared gumdrops with 26 white sugar-crystal dots.
Candy-cane fence: red licorice rails, striped posts with dashed hooks.
Wrapped-candy boulders; chocolate gravestones with piped frosting 'R.I.P.' and a bead border; orange gourd-shaped candy buckets.
Cupcake house: pleated liner, 3-tier frosting roof, sprinkles, a cherry and warm glowing windows.
Props are chosen by ground material and keep the top-left key light, white specs and lower-right rim of the characters.

Placement is composed: lollipop groves (colour matched to the ground) ringed by gumdrop bushes, candy-cane fences and wrapped-candy boulders along the cookie path, little graveyards of gravestones and buckets on the chocolate, the odd cupcake house; nothing on caramel or on the path.
Lollipops sway on their sticks and gumdrop bushes jiggle, slowly and each on its own phase.

effects.name: Seed projectile
effects.how: Glossy candy-seed sprite (gloss + 1.6x0.55 spec) flipping scaleY 0.6-1.0 with |cos(spin)|, behind it a 13-unit white gradient streak (1.6 wide) with two thin pink side streaks rgba(255,140,190,.9).

effects.name: Impact star
effects.how: 8-point rounded star (r 5.6/2.4) filled white -> #fff4fa -> #ffb3d6 with a hot-pink #ff5c9e outline 0.35, life 0.14 s, scale 0.5 -> 1.2 -> 0.3; plus a few sprinkles and an additive sugar sparkle.

effects.name: Sprinkle burst
effects.how: Capsule sprinkles (2.3x0.9 units, white top highlight line, dark bottom line, 0.18 outline) in 7 colours, thrown with vz 50-120, gravity 300, drag 1.4, spinning ±8 rad/s; shrink in the last 20% of life.

effects.name: Candy pop-out
effects.how: A disappearing figure squashes up to 1.25x with a 44 rad/s wobble, flashes white, gone after 0.42 s. Gummies burst into 6 gummy chunks, the large creature into chocolate shards, caramel drops, candy corn, cream puffs and a striped shock ring; marshmallow figures burst into 5 marshmallow puffs.

effects.name: Wrapper reveal
effects.how: Ground figures pop out of an unwrapping candy wrapper decal (zig-zag edge, white-banded gradient, dark centre) with outElastic scale-in and confetti; the wrapper fades after 70% of the reveal time.

effects.name: Collectibles
effects.how: Wrapped candies: glossy body, 3-arm spiral swirl (width 0.28r), cellophane ends with white crease lines, spec at (-0.38r, -0.42r). Small = blue #2fb8ff r 2.4, large = orange #ffb11f with a pink swirl r 3.6.

effects.name: Orbiting lantern
effects.how: A small two-layer gummy bulb (cream bottom, purple top) with a caramel-hole face and an additive warm glow.

effects.name: Sugar sparkles
effects.how: Additive ('lighter') 4-point sparkle (quadratic star, tip 3.6) over a soft coloured radial glow, twinkling with sin(t*2.2); also drift slowly in the air in one per 140-unit cell.

effects.name: Celebration ring
effects.how: Ellipse ring (ry = 0.45 rx) expanding with outQuad, stroked cocoa (w+1.2), then white, then a dashed [2.2, 2.6] pink line; plus 22 sprinkles, 14 flipping confetti rectangles and 8 sparkles.

atmosphere.summary: Studio candy-ad lighting: one key light from the top-left on everything, warm cocoa-plum soft shadows, additive caramel glows behind light sources, drifting sugar sparkles in the air and a plum radial vignette – never black.
rules: Key light top-left everywhere (gradient centre offset -0.38r, -0.45r); speculars always upper-left, rim light lower-right.

Shadows: a 64x32 baked radial ellipse rgba(45,12,22,.42) -> .3 @55% -> 0, stretched per figure: main character 9x3.2 (shrinking while airborne), small creature 9x3.2, floating creature 6.2x2.2 at 70%, large creature 20x6, collectibles 3.2x1.3, projectiles 2.6x1 offset 6 down.

Glows: additive radial glow sprite (36 units; rgba(255,200,90,.8) -> rgba(255,160,60,.32) @35% -> 0) behind the main character's head (alpha 0.32 ± 0.06) and lanterns; shadowBlur glow baked into caramel cracks and glowing eyes.
Ambient sugar sparkles: one per 140-unit cell (60% of cells), drifting and twinkling, additive.
Vignette: radial from (50%, 46%), inner r 0.35h to outer 0.62w: rgba(60,10,50,0) -> .16 @70% -> rgba(50,8,40,.42). Plum, not black.
Full-screen overlays tint rgba(70,20,60,.62) with a pink glow and a rotating sunburst; a sombre variant desaturates.

ui.summary: Chunky candy-shop HUD: thick #3a1424 borders with a 4-5 px solid drop below (like a pressed candy button), glossy top-half white gloss overlay on everything, peppermint-striped bars in dark chocolate troughs, an orange wrapped-candy timer badge, a pink pill counter with sprinkle dots, Chewy numbers with a 16-direction cocoa outline.

motion: Smooth interpolated motion; everything jelly rings on after it moves - a damped oscillation follows every contact, hit and landing.

Main character jelly hop (anim*0.42): landing squash that rings on (e^(-14f)cos(28f), sy -15%), crouch before take-off (9%), stretch while airborne, lift 3.4, tilt 0.07*air; sugar puff on 60% of landings.
Gummy creatures: 4 frames at anim*0.85 + seed, bob 1.6; every contact sets off a jiggle that lags the gait (e^(-9f)cos(24f), ±10%). Large creature: cubic contact squash 6% + slower jiggle 5%.
Marshmallow floating creatures: 6 fps frames, hover 4.5 + 1.6 sin(2.6t), squash ±5%, tilt by velocity.
Hit: jelly spring e^(-8t)cos(30t) (±22%) with a 0.26 rad tilt away from the blow and the flash overlay.
Removal over deathT 0..1: gummies wobble, over-inflate to 1.38x and pop at 0.34 into the layered burst; whipped cream sags, spreads, slides into a puddle and fades.
Appearing: the wrapper decal unwraps under the figure; gummies scale in with outElastic, marshmallows with outBack.
Props: lollipops sway (sin(1.1t)*0.03), gumdrops jiggle (±2.5%); collectibles bob and pop with outBack; numbers pop 0.3 -> 1.35 -> 1.
do: Fill every shape with the top-left radial gradient (light, mid @0.5, dark) and add a white specular ellipse at about (-0.4r, -0.45r).
Add a lower-right rim light (clipped stroke, gradient transparent until 60%) to round, glossy parts.
Choose a real candy material per object (hard candy, gummy, licorice, marshmallow, chocolate, frosting) and stay consistent with it.
Wrap each finished sprite in one soft 0.5-unit cocoa #3a1424 outline.
Make faces glow: carved caramel holes or glossy dark eyes with yellow and white catchlights.
Use sprinkles, sugar sparkles and confetti for every impact, collectible and pop-out.
Keep shadows warm cocoa-plum and soft (radial ellipse, 0.42 alpha centre).
dont: Do not use flat fills or hard cel bands - that turns it into generic vector cartoon.
Do not use black outlines or inner ink lines.
Do not light from different directions per object; the highlight is always top-left.
Do not use grey or blue shadows; everything warm.
Do not saturate the ground as much as the characters - the floor must stay calmer.
Do not add more than ~7 hues on screen per material group; candy chaos ruins readability in large groups of figures.
Do not draw gradients per frame for every figure - bake sprites.
Don't scatter sprinkles and sweets evenly over the ground - put them in a few spills and keep the floor calm.
performance: All characters, props, collectibles and particles are baked once into canvases at K px/unit (4 walk frames + flash tint + mirrored copies), so a frame is mostly drawImage calls plus a few additive glows. The ground is the hot spot: per-pixel distance fields over a 4-unit grid with bilinear interpolation, computed in a generator in 256-unit chunks and capped at 2.5 px/unit; decals are stamped into the chunk afterwards. Floating numbers are cached per value (max 400). The vignette is a 320 px sprite stretched over the screen.
